name: ai-bug-scoring
description: PM bug scoring with system A2: deterministic selection, ticket preparation and score writing around a headless Claude Code agent

scripts.package: ncc build src/select/main.ts -o select-bugs/dist --license licenses.txt && ncc build src/prepare/main.ts -o dist/prepare --license licenses.txt && ncc build src/score/main.ts -o dist/apply-scores --license licenses.txt && ncc build src/summarize/main.ts -o dist/summarize-run --license licenses.txt
scripts.all: npm run build && npm run format-check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run package
